entries.title: Proverbs 22:1
segments: A [good] name [is] rather to be chosen than great riches; [and] loving favor rather than silver or gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:2
segments: The rich and poor meet together; the LORD [is] the maker of them all.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:3
segments: A prudent one foresees the evil and hides himself, but the simple pass on and are punished.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:4
segments: By humility [and] the fear of the LORD [are] riches and honor and life.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:5
segments: Thorns [and] snares [are] in the way of the perverse; he who keeps his soul shall be far from them.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:6
segments: Train up a child in the way he should go; and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:7
segments: The rich rules over the poor, and the borrower [is] servant to the lender.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:8
segments: He who sows iniquity shall reap vanity; and the rod of his anger shall fail.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:9
segments: He who has a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he gives of his bread to the poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:10
segments: Cast out the scorner, and fighting shall go out; yes, quarrels and shame shall cease.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:11
segments: He who loves pureness of heart, grace is on his lips; the king [shall be] his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:12
segments: The eyes of the LORD keep knowledge, and He overthrows the words of the transgressor.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:13
segments: The lazy one says, [There is] a lion outside; I shall be killed in the streets.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:14
segments: The mouth of strange women [is] a deep pit; those despised [by] the LORD shall fall there.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:15
segments: Foolishness [is] bound in the heart of a child; the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:16
segments: He who crushes the poor to multiply for himself, and he who gives to the rich, only [to come] to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:17
segments: Bow down your ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply your heart to My knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:18
segments: For [it is] a pleasant thing if you keep them within you; they shall all be fitted in your lips,

entries.title: Proverbs 22:19
segments: so that your trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to you this day, even to you.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:20
segments: Have I not written to you excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

entries.title: Proverbs 22:21
segments: that I might make you know the sureness of the words of truth; to return the words of truth to those who send to you?

entries.title: Proverbs 22:22
segments: Do not rob the poor, because he [is] poor; nor press down the afflicted in the gate;

entries.title: Proverbs 22:23
segments: for the LORD will plead their cause, and strip the soul of those who plunder them.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:24
segments: Make no friendship with an angry man; and you shall not go up with a man of fury,

entries.title: Proverbs 22:25
segments: lest you learn his ways and get a snare to your soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:26
segments: Be not one of those who strike hands, of those who are sureties for debts.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:27
segments: If you have nothing to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

entries.title: Proverbs 22:28
segments: Do not remove the old landmark which your fathers have set.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:29
segments: Do you see a man diligent in his business? He shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before unknown [men].
